entities.summary: Khas Malla, a notable figure in the history of Nepal, associated with Thakuri Transitional Period and Western Kingdoms (1100–1400). Preceded by Khas Malla Western Kingdom and Licchavi Thakuri. Their legacy influenced Prithvi Narayan Shah conquers the Kathmandu Valley, unifying Nepal.
